Build scope

What Commercial Fit-Out includes

The scope is shaped around the business, but the delivery stays joined up. Every trade follows one layout, one BOQ and one site programme.

01Space divisionDrywall, glass, doors and functional zones.
02CeilingsGypsum, grid, open and acoustic systems.
03FlooringTile, vinyl, wood-look, epoxy and level correction.
04Electrical and lightingLoad planning, circuits, fixtures and emergency lighting.
05Plumbing and HVACWashrooms, pantry, drainage and cooling coordination.
06Joinery and furnitureReception, workstations, counters, displays and storage.
07Finishes and brandingPaint, wall panels, signage and branded details.
08Testing and handoverSnagging, service checks, cleaning and final release for operations.

A controlled programme

7 steps from brief to handover

Decisions are approved in sequence so the site team can build with fewer changes and clearer accountability.

01

Survey

Assess the shell, utilities, access and building rules.

02

Plan

Resolve business zones, circulation and built-in elements.

03

BOQ

Agree itemized quantities, price, milestones and timeline.

04

Select

Approve materials, fixtures, finishes and samples.

05

Build

Coordinate partitions, services, floors, ceilings and finishes.

06

Install

Fit joinery, furniture, signage and final details.

07

Handover

Test, snag, clean and release the space for operations.

Practical answers

Commercial Fit-Out FAQs

Six short answers about scope, timing and cost.

Office fit-out is one type of commercial fit-out. Commercial fit-out also covers retail, restaurants, clinics, showrooms and coworking spaces.

A standard 1,000–3,000 sq. ft. project usually takes 3–6 weeks after design approval. Complex kitchens and larger spaces take longer.

Yes. We regularly start with empty shells and coordinate partitions, ceilings, floors, services, joinery, furniture and finishing.

Not always. We can build from approved drawings, develop the design with you, or combine design and fit-out as a turnkey service.

Yes. We coordinate access, working hours, service connections and the technical information needed for building approvals or NOCs.

items.q: How is commercial fit-out different from office fit-out?
items.a: Office fit-out is one type of commercial fit-out. Commercial fit-out also covers retail, restaurants, clinics, showrooms and coworking spaces.

items.q: How long does a commercial fit-out take?
items.a: A standard 1,000–3,000 sq. ft. project usually takes 3–6 weeks after design approval. Complex kitchens and larger spaces take longer.

items.q: Do you work with empty shells?
items.a: Yes. We regularly start with empty shells and coordinate partitions, ceilings, floors, services, joinery, furniture and finishing.

items.q: Do I need a design first?
items.a: Not always. We can build from approved drawings, develop the design with you, or combine design and fit-out as a turnkey service.

items.q: Can you coordinate with building management?
items.a: Yes. We coordinate access, working hours, service connections and the technical information needed for building approvals or NOCs.
Yes. Woodex Furniture™ can manufacture project-specific reception desks, workstations, counters, displays and storage.
